content:
This is a poster or program for a theatrical event called "Festival d'Avignon" featuring a production titled "ÉCLIPSE." The image shows an artistic black and white illustration with a shadowy silhouette against a light background. 

The poster includes performance dates at the top: various dates in July (11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 30, 31) and August (1st and 2nd) at 22h (10 PM).

The venue is listed as "CHATEAUBLANC-PARC DES EXPOSITIONS."

At the bottom, it states "Conception et mise en scène, Bartabas" indicating that Bartabas is the director/creator of the show. There appears to be a seal or stamp from the Bibliothèque Nationale, and sponsors including Crédit Local de France - Groupe Dexia are mentioned.

The document appears to be from 1997, as indicated by a notation in the top right corner.
